# Figure 3

## 3B

```{r}
# Create list from results
cv_results_list <- list(
  "IMC" = BF_IMC,
  "IMC_all" = BF_IMC_all
  )

# Define colors 
col_cv <- setNames(c("firebrick1", "grey"),
c("SELECTED", "ALL"))

# Initialize list to store IBS scores for each cross-validation result
ibs_scores_list <- list()
ibs_scores_list <- lapply(cv_results_list, function(res_obj) {
  sapply(res_obj, function(res) {
    if (nrow(res$actual_surv) != nrow(res$actual_test)) {
      stop("Row count mismatch between actual_surv and actual_test")
    }
    test_data <- cbind(res$actual_surv, res$actual_test)
    times_test <- sort(unique(test_data$OS_months))
    if(!0 %in% times_test){
    times_test <- c(0, times_test)
    }
    times_pred <- res$predictions$unique.death.times
    time_indices <- sapply(times_test, function(t) which.min(abs(times_pred - t)))
    aligned_surv_probs <- res$predictions$survival[, time_indices, drop = FALSE]
    pec_obj <- pec(
      object = list("BlockForest" = aligned_surv_probs),
      formula = Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ 1,
      cens.model = "marginal",
      exact = TRUE,
      data = test_data
    )
    IBSrange <- quantile(test_data$OS_months, 0.9)
    crps_val <- crps(pec_obj, start = 0, times = IBSrange)
    ibs_score <- crps_val[2] 
    return(ibs_score)
  })
})

out_ibs <- data.frame(fold = 1:10, t(do.call("rbind", ibs_scores_list))[1:10,]) %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.), names_to = "model", values_to = "IBS")
out_ibs$cat <- ifelse(str_detect(out_ibs$model, "all"), "ALL", "SELECTED")
out_ibs$type <- str_split(out_ibs$model, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1]

# Plot
ggplot(out_ibs, aes(x = cat, y = IBS, fill = cat))+
  geom_point(aes(color = cat))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(aes(group=cat), ref.group = "ALL", paired = FALSE, method = "t.test", method.args = list(alternative = "less", label = "p.format"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_cv)+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_cv)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Models")+
  ylab("Integrated Brier Score")
```

## 3E 

```{r}
variable_importance <- sapply(BF_IMC, function(res) {
  res$variable_importance
})

# Scaled importance per fold
plot_importance <- variable_importance %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("feature") %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.),names_to = "fold", values_to = "importance") %>% group_by(fold) %>% mutate(scaled_importance = scale(importance))
plot_importance$scaled_importance_total <- as.vector(scale(plot_importance$importance))

# Add feature information
plot_importance$feature_origin <- ifelse(str_detect(plot_importance$feature, "_TU"), "TU", 
                            ifelse(str_detect(plot_importance$feature, "_MY"), "MY", 
                                   ifelse(str_detect(plot_importance$feature, "_T_"), "T", NA)))
plot_importance$feature_type <- ifelse(str_detect(plot_importance$feature, "_EXP"), "EXP", 
                            ifelse(str_detect(plot_importance$feature, "_MC"), "MC", 
                                   ifelse(str_detect(plot_importance$feature, "_D"), "D", 
                                          ifelse(str_detect(plot_importance$feature, "_INT"), "INT", NA)))) 
plot_importance$feature_spatial <- ifelse(plot_importance$feature_type %in% c("EXP", "MC"), "non_spatial", ifelse(plot_importance$feature_type %in% c("D", "INT"), "spatial", NA))

# Define colors 
col_origin <- setNames(c("#825CA6", "#F2B342", "#317EC2"),c("TU", "MY", "T"))
col_type <- setNames(c("#1F78B4","#A6CEE3", "#B2DF8A", "#33A02C"),c("EXP", "MC", "INT", "D"))
col_spatial <- setNames(c("#377EB8","#4DAF4A"),c("non_spatial", "spatial"))

# Order features
ordered_features <- plot_importance %>% group_by(feature) %>% summarize(median = median(scaled_importance), mean = mean(scaled_importance))
ordered_features <- ordered_features %>% arrange(desc(median))
ordered_features$diff_median <- c(abs(diff(ordered_features %>% arrange(desc(median)) %>% pull(median))), 0)
ordered_features$diff_median_mean <- c(abs(diff(ordered_features %>% arrange(desc(median)) %>% pull(mean))), 0)
ordered_features <- ordered_features %>% arrange(desc(mean))
ordered_features$diff_mean <- c(abs(diff(ordered_features %>% arrange(desc(mean)) %>% pull(mean))), 0)

# Select most important features (TOP30)
ordered_features_median <- ordered_features %>% filter(median > -0.15) %>% pull(feature)      
top_features <- ordered_features_median

# Add hazard direction
key_out <- features_selected %>%
  select(PID, status_OS, OS_months, all_of(top_features)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("PID")
out_df <- key_out
hazard_surv_out <- foreach(
  x = colnames(out_df %>% select(-status_OS, -OS_months)), 
  .combine = "rbind"
) %do% {
  med_val <- median(out_df[[x]], na.rm = TRUE)
  group_var <- ifelse(out_df[[x]] > med_val, "High", "Low")
  fit <- survdiff(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ group_var, data = out_df)
  
  data.frame(
    group   = x,
    p       = 1 - pchisq(fit$chisq, length(fit$n) - 1), 
    obs_2   = fit$obs[1],
    exp_2   = fit$exp[1],
    ratio   = fit$obs[1] / fit$exp[1]
  )
}

hazard_surv_out <- hazard_surv_out %>% mutate(direction = ifelse(ratio > 1, "high", "low")) %>%
  arrange(ratio)  

# Plot
heatmap <- plot_importance %>% ungroup %>% select(feature, fold, scaled_importance) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "fold", names_from = "feature", values_from = "scaled_importance") %>% column_to_rownames("fold")

heatmap <- heatmap[,match(ordered_features %>% arrange(desc(median)) %>% pull(feature), colnames(heatmap))]
anno <- plot_importance %>% ungroup %>% select(feature, feature_origin, feature_type, feature_spatial) %>% unique()
anno$top_feature <- anno$feature %in% top_features
anno$hazard_dir <- hazard_surv_out$direction[match(anno$feature, hazard_surv_out$group)]
col_top <- setNames(c("black", "grey"),c(TRUE, FALSE))
col_hazard <- setNames(c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8"),c("high", "low"))
anno <- anno[match(colnames(heatmap), anno$feature),]
median_diff <- plot_importance %>% ungroup %>% select(feature) %>% unique()
median_diff$diff_median <- ordered_features$diff_median[match(median_diff$feature, ordered_features$feature)]
median_diff$diff_median_mean <- ordered_features$diff_median_mean[match(median_diff$feature, ordered_features$feature)]
median_diff <- median_diff[match(colnames(heatmap), median_diff$feature),]

HeatmapAnnotation(
  importance = anno_boxplot(heatmap, 
                         gp = gpar(fill = "white"), box_width = 0.75,
                         height = unit(4,"cm"), outline = FALSE,
                         show_row_names = FALSE),
  median_diff = anno_lines(median_diff[,2:3], gp = gpar(col = c("black", "grey")),height = unit(1.5,"cm")),
  top = anno$top_feature,
  hazard = anno$hazard_dir,
  origin = anno$feature_origin, 
  type = anno$feature_type, 
  spatial = anno$feature_spatial,
  col = list(top = col_top,
             hazard = col_hazard,
             origin = col_origin,
             type = col_type,
             spatial = col_spatial
             ),
  text = anno_text(colnames(heatmap)),
  gap = unit(1,"mm"),
  border = TRUE
)%v%NULL
```

## 3F 

```{r}
# DEFINE SURVIVAL ECOTYPES BASED ON TOP FEATURES
key_out <- features_selected %>% select(PID, all_of(top_features)) %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

set.seed(22)
h_select <- Heatmap(key_out, 
        row_km = 3, 
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
        row_km_repeats = 1000)
h_select <- draw(h_select)

## Selection 
row_order_h_ag <- row_order(h_select)
anno <- key_out %>% rownames_to_column("PID") %>% select(PID)
anno$PID_group <- NA
foreach(i = seq_along(row_order_h_ag))%do%{
anno$PID_group <- as.factor((ifelse(rownames(anno) %in% row_order_h_ag[[i]], i, anno$PID_group)))
}
anno$PID_group_final <- unfactor(anno$PID_group)

## Add survival ecotype information
features_selected$survival_ecotype <- anno$PID_group_final[match(features_selected$PID, anno$PID)]
features_selected$survival_ecotype[features_selected$survival_ecotype == "1"] <- "Medium"
features_selected$survival_ecotype[features_selected$survival_ecotype == "2"] <- "Poor"
features_selected$survival_ecotype[features_selected$survival_ecotype == "3"] <- "Favorable"
features_selected$survival_ecotype <- factor(features_selected$survival_ecotype)

# VISUALIZE
key_aggregated <- features_selected %>% select(survival_ecotype, all_of(top_features)) %>% pivot_longer(cols = 2:ncol(.),names_to = "feature", values_to = "score") %>% group_by(survival_ecotype, feature) %>% summarize(mean = mean(score)) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = 1, names_from = "feature", values_from = "mean") %>% column_to_rownames("survival_ecotype")

# Add rowAnno
row_anno <- plot_importance %>% ungroup %>% filter(feature %in% top_features) %>% select(feature, feature_origin, feature_type, feature_spatial) %>% unique()

row_anno$hazard <- hazard_surv_out$direction[match(row_anno$feature, hazard_surv_out$group)]
row_anno <- row_anno[match(colnames(key_aggregated), row_anno$feature),]

ha_types <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    hazard = row_anno$hazard,
    origin = row_anno$feature_origin,
    type = row_anno$feature_type,
    spatial = row_anno$feature_spatial, 
    col = list(hazard = col_hazard, 
               origin = col_origin,
               type = col_type,
               spatial = col_spatial),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

## Define colors
col_group <- setNames(c("#0571B0", "gold3", "#CA0020"),c("Favorable","Medium","Poor"))

# Add colAnno
col_anno <- key_aggregated %>% rownames_to_column("PID_group") %>% select(PID_group)
ca <- columnAnnotation(PID_group = anno_simple(col_anno, col = col_group))

# Plot
Heatmap(t(key_aggregated))+ 
  ha_types+
  rowAnnotation(text = anno_text(row_anno$feature))
```

## S4C 

```{r}
# Create list from results
cv_results_list <- list(
  "IMC" = BF_IMC,
  "IMC_all" = BF_IMC_all
  )

# Define colors 
col_cv <- setNames(c("firebrick1", "grey"),
c("SELECTED", "ALL"))

# Initialize list to store concordance scores for each cross-validation result
concordance_scores_list <- list()
concordance_scores_list <- lapply(cv_results_list, function(res_obj) {
  sapply(res_obj, function(res) {
    out <- concordance(Surv(res$actual_surv[, 1], res$actual_surv[, 2]) ~ rowSums(res$predictions$survival), timewt = "n/G2")
    return(out$concordance)
  })
})

out_concordance <- data.frame(fold = 1:10, t(do.call("rbind", concordance_scores_list))[1:10,]) %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.), names_to = "model", values_to = "concordance")
out_concordance$cat <- ifelse(str_detect(out_concordance$model, "all"), "ALL", "SELECTED")
out_concordance$type <- str_split(out_concordance$model, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1]

# Plot
ggplot(out_concordance, aes(x = cat, y = concordance, fill = cat))+
  geom_point(aes(color = cat))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(aes(group=cat), ref.group = "ALL", paired = FALSE, method = "t.test", method.args = list(alternative = "greater", label = "p.format"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_cv)+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_cv)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Models")+
  ylab("Concordance (Uno)")
```

## S4D 

```{r}
celltype_density_1 <- celltype_density %>% filter(celltype_combined_broad != "Unknown_Other")
general_count_out <- celltype_density_1 %>% group_by(PID, celltype_combined_broad) %>% summarise(Freq = round(mean(Freq), digits = 0))
general_count_wide <- general_count_out %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = celltype_combined_broad, values_from = Freq) %>% ungroup() %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% filter(complete.cases(.)) %>% t()

### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
# Here as an approximation, we use the mean count of cell types across panels (rounded to an integer).
DA <- lapply(c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","necrose","PDL1_score"), function(x){
abundances <- general_count_wide
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 
meta <- as.data.frame(metadata_selected[match(colnames(abundances), metadata_selected$PID),])
if (x %in% c("necrose")) {
  meta[, x] <- relevel(x = factor(meta[, x]), ref = "NE0")
} else if (x %in% c("ISUP_combined")) {
  meta[, x] <- relevel(x = factor(meta[, x]), ref = "G1/2")
} else if (x %in% c("pT_combined")) {
  meta[, x] <- relevel(x = factor(meta[, x]), ref = "T1/2")
} else if (x %in% c("PDL1_score")) {
  meta[, x] <- relevel(x = factor(meta[, x]), ref = "PD0")
}
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")
fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))
DA <- res$table
DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table
DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))
DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x
return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)

# Filter 
MC_diff_abun <- DA_out %>% filter(sign == TRUE) %>% group_by(cluster, result) %>% dplyr::count() %>% filter(n >= 2) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unique() %>% unfactor()

DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category,levels = c("PDL1_score", "necrose","pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))
DA_out_fil <- DA_out[DA_out$cluster %in% MC_diff_abun, ]

ggplot(DA_out_fil, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out_fil,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Disease progression")
```

```{r}
general_dens_wide <- general_dens_out %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = celltype_combined_broad, values_from = density) %>% ungroup() %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% filter(complete.cases(.))

# 1. MEAN
## MULTIVARIABLE COX MODEL
Cox_df <- general_dens_wide
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = Cox_df %>% colnames,.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(i) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}
colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)
Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)
Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- celltype_density$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),celltype_density$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- celltype_density$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),celltype_density$PID)]
covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames
multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))
multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)
multi_res <- summary(multi_model)
plot_df_dens_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],3))


# 2. MEDIAN
## MULTIVARIABLE COX MODEL
Cox_df <- general_dens_wide
Cox_df_median <- foreach(i = Cox_df %>% colnames,.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(i) %>% mutate(median = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > median(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(median)
}
colnames(Cox_df_median) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_median) <- rownames(Cox_df)
Cox_df_median <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_median)
Cox_df_median$status_OS <- celltype_density$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_median),celltype_density$PID)]
Cox_df_median$OS_months <- celltype_density$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_median),celltype_density$PID)]
covariates <- Cox_df_median %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames
multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))
multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_median)
multi_res <- summary(multi_model)
plot_df_dens_median <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],3))

# Combined visualization in dot plot
cox_median <- plot_df_dens_median %>% mutate(sign = p_value < 0.05, result = ifelse(plot_df_dens_median$HR > 1 & plot_df_dens_median$p_value < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(plot_df_dens_median$HR < 1 & plot_df_dens_median$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% mutate(category = "median") %>% arrange(desc(HR))
cox_median$group <- factor(cox_median$group, levels = cox_median$group)

cox_mean <- plot_df_dens_mean %>% mutate(sign = p_value < 0.05, result = ifelse(plot_df_dens_mean$HR > 1 & plot_df_dens_mean$p_value < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(plot_df_dens_mean$HR < 1 & plot_df_dens_mean$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% mutate(category = "mean") %>% arrange(desc(HR))
cox_mean$group <- factor(cox_mean$group, levels = cox_mean$group)

plot_cox_combined <- rbind(cox_mean, cox_median)
plot_cox_combined$type <- "phenotypes"
plot_cox_combined_fil <- plot_cox_combined %>% filter(result != "NOTSIG")
both <- plot_cox_combined_fil %>% group_by(group,result) %>% count() %>% filter(n > 1) %>% pull(group) %>% unfactor()
plot_cox_combined_fil$category <- ifelse(plot_cox_combined_fil$group %in% both, "both", plot_cox_combined_fil$category)
plot_cox_combined_fil <- plot_cox_combined_fil %>% group_by(group, category) %>% reframe(HR = mean(HR), p_value = mean(p_value), result = result, type = type) %>% unique()

ggplot(plot_cox_combined_fil, aes(x=reorder(group,HR), y = type, shape = category, col = HR, size= -log10(p_value)))+
  geom_point()+
```

## S4L

```{r}
# Update for association testing
metadata_selected$pT_combined[metadata_selected$pT_combined == "T1/2"] <- "0"
metadata_selected$pT_combined[metadata_selected$pT_combined == "T3/4"] <- "1"
metadata_selected$ISUP_combined[metadata_selected$ISUP_combined == "G1/2"] <- "0"
metadata_selected$ISUP_combined[metadata_selected$ISUP_combined == "G3/4"] <- "1"
metadata_selected$necrose[metadata_selected$necrose == "NE0"] <- "0"
metadata_selected$necrose[metadata_selected$necrose == "NE1"] <- "1"
metadata_selected$PDL1_score[metadata_selected$PDL1_score == "PD0"] <- "0"
metadata_selected$PDL1_score[metadata_selected$PDL1_score == "PD1"] <- "1"

# Patient group info 
cur_groups <- metadata_selected %>% select(PID,Poor,Medium,Favorable) %>% unique()
cur_test <- metadata_selected %>% select(PID, pT_combined, ISUP_combined, necrose, PDL1_score) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% filter(complete.cases(.)) %>% t()
cur_groups <- cur_groups[cur_groups$PID %in% colnames(cur_test),]

# Function to perform Fisher exact test
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
 
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("Favorable", "Medium","Poor"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_test, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  return(fisher_results)
}

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.05, "UP",
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.05, "DOWN","NOTSIG"))

# Plot
cur_df <- fisher_full %>% select(gene, category, odds_ratio) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = odds_ratio, names_from = gene)
## Row order
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
row_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = cur_df$category)
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = c("Poor", "Medium", "Favorable"))
## Column order
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
column_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$gene <- factor(fisher_full$gene, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))
fisher_full$gene <- factor(fisher_full$gene, levels = c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined", "necrose", "PDL1_score"))

ggplot(fisher_full, aes(x=category, y = gene,col = odds_ratio, size = -log10(p_adj)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_adj), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  coord_flip()
```

```{r}
area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))

ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = area_col,
               eccentricity = eccentricity_col,
               n_neighbors = n_neighbors_col),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")


## 2.2 Metadata features
# Number of cells per endo_metacluster_names 
n_cells <- colData(mean_sce_endo) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(endo_metacluster_names, ncells)
# Number of contributing patients
cluster_PID <- colData(sce_endo) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(endo_metacluster_names,PID) %>% group_by(endo_metacluster_names) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
n_PID <- cluster_PID %>% group_by(endo_metacluster_names) %>% filter(Freq > 0) %>% count(name = "n_PID") %>% column_to_rownames("endo_metacluster_names")

ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  n_cells = anno_barplot(n_cells$ncells, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),                        
  n_PID = anno_barplot(n_PID$n_PID, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),

                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                            which = "row")

### 3. Define broader categories
anno <- colData(mean_sce_endo) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(endo_metacluster_names, ncells)

### 4. Plot
h <- Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce_endo, "min_max")),
        col = viridis(100),
        name = "min_max",
        row_title = NULL,
        show_row_names = FALSE, 
        show_row_dend = TRUE,
        row_names_side = "left",
        show_column_names =  TRUE,
        row_split = anno$endo_metacluster_names,
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
        cluster_row_slices = TRUE)+
  Heatmap(scale(t(assay(mean_sce_endo, "min_max"))))+
  rowAnnotation(metacluster = anno_text(anno$endo_metacluster_names), border = TRUE)+
  ha_spatial+
  ha_meta

draw(h)
```

## S5D

```{r}
# Add survival ecotypes to SCE
sce_TU$survival_ecotype <- metadata_selected$survival_ecotype[match(sce_TU$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]
sce_TU <- sce_TU[,!is.na(sce_TU$survival_ecotype)]

sce_TU$Poor <- ifelse(sce_TU$survival_ecotype == "Poor", "1", "0")
sce_TU$Favorable <- ifelse(sce_TU$survival_ecotype == "Favorable", "1", "0")
sce_TU$Medium<- ifelse(sce_TU$survival_ecotype == "Medium", "1", "0")

# Compare differential abundance using edgeR
DA <- lapply(c("Poor", "Favorable","Medium"), function(x){
abundances <- table(sce_TU$endo_metacluster_names, sce_TU$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% names(colSums(abundances))[colSums(abundances) != 0]]
meta <- colData(sce_TU)[match(colnames(abundances), sce_TU$PID),]
meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")
fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))
DA <- res$table
DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table
DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))
DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x
return(DA)
})
DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)

# Plot
ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```
